description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayChannelRequest functionality within the Gateway module of the OpenClaw project. It defines a test struct with an asynchronous test method that verifies request timeout behavior and error handling in the WebSocket session context.

classes.name: GatewayChannelRequestTests
classes.description: A test suite struct for verifying Gateway channel request behaviors, particularly timeouts and error handling.

methods.name: makeSession
methods.description: Creates a mock WebSocket session with a send hook that delays response and then throws a connection error.

methods.name: `request timeout then send failure does not double resume`
methods.description: An asynchronous test method that checks that a request times out correctly without double resuming, even when a subsequent send failure occurs.
